context_requirements: PTAFR expression and functional G-protein coupling
presence of PAF or PAF-like phospholipid agonists
inflammatory or stress signaling context to reveal antagonist effects
falsifiers: reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
enrichment of NF-kB, AP-1 or inflammatory gene signatures after treatment
PTAFR-dependent transcriptional response in a cell line with low PTAFR expression

evidence.supports: A PAF receptor antagonist reduced experimental corneal inflammation in rabbits, indicating anti-inflammatory activity in vivo.
Lysophosphatidylcholine, a phospholipid related to PAF signaling, activated NF-kB and AP-1 in AR42J cells, showing potential inflammatory transcriptional links.
A PAF receptor antagonist did not affect viral vector transduction in murine tracheal epithelium, suggesting no broad transcriptional effect in that model.
